title: LGD project fix configuration
description: Strict JSON settings for .vscode/lgd.json. The nearest configuration defines the project root. Invalid settings disable all configured fixes.

autoFix.description: Enable supported automatic rules on save. A rule also needs fix: automatic; unsafe rules remain review-only.

extends.description: Relative ./ or ../ JSON files resolved from this file, inside the workspace including symlink targets. Parents merge in order before this file. Maximum 10 levels and 100 files; all globs use this project root.

ignores.description: Additional project-root-relative files to exclude. Inherited ignores accumulate. Built-in exclusions cannot be overridden.

overrides.description: Apply matching rule settings in order. Each override ignores entry excludes only that override.

formatting.description: Optional editor-independent LGD style rules. Disabled by default; source readers never execute configuration JavaScript.

sources.description: Data-only project preferences, lowest to highest priority. Empty means native preferences only.

patterns.description: Project-root-relative slash-separated globs: * and ? within a segment; ** as a whole segment. A trailing / includes descendants. No negation, braces, character classes, extglobs, absolute paths, or .. segments. Example: src/**/*.lgd
